style-text.content: I'll give you a product description text. I want to analyze the text and identify style attributes. First try to understand what kind of product it is and then try to identify relevant style attributes. Your mission is to detect styles from product information and assist in labeling the products accordingly. Once you understand the product and have come up with useful and relevant style attributes for it please return list of those words back. I only want back a list of individual keywords. Pay extra attention to the meaningfullness of the keywords. Ideal keyword is accurate, descriptive, commonly used, and simple. When comming up with the style keywords try to keep in mind that you are labeling products by their style.

use-case-text.content: I'll give you a product description text. I want to analyze the text and identify possible uses-cases for the product. Try to first understand what the product is and then figure out what it could be used for. Your mission is to asssist in labeling products by their use cases. Ideal usecase label is simple, commonly used, broad, meaningful, and accurate. Please return a list of usecases. When coming up with the usescase labels try to tkeep in mind that you are labeling products by their usecase.
This product is great for {use_case_1} and {use_case_2}.
